expectations.text: Recommends NOT adding a LabelsService / domain layer / per-endpoint use-case classes for this module
expectations.evidence: 'я не раджу робити LabelsService, domain/-шар і 4 класи use-case'.

expectations.text: Justifies it by the module being CRUD without business logic (cost of an extra layer > value)
expectations.evidence: Pure CRUD, no business rules, one port, no transactions; wrappers give no gain.

expectations.text: Confirms the existing shape already respects the dependency rule (routes do not touch drizzle; repository owns queries)
expectations.evidence: 'drizzle тільки в repository.ts, у routes немає drizzle-orm / db/*'.

expectations.text: Notes that repository methods are already scoped by workspaceId
expectations.evidence: 'Кожен метод репозиторію приймає workspaceId і скоупить по ньому.'

expectations.text: Names concrete signals that would warrant introducing a service later (duplicated rule, branching on business state, a second port, etc.)
expectations.evidence: Skill signals plus labels examples: limit, in-use delete ban, merge with UnitOfWork, GitHub sync second port.

expectations.text: Does not report any fabricated architectural violation in the labels module
expectations.evidence: Duplicate-name 500 noted as a repository-level concern, not a layering violation; no fabricated violation.

expectations.text: Does not create a set of new service/use-case/domain files as the main deliverable
expectations.evidence: 'нічого нового не створювати'; future service table is conditional.
